steps.title: Set up Basic Project Structure
steps.description: Initialize the standard Android project structure including manifest, build scripts, and core Java/layout files.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Specify the application's name and package identifier in the project metadata file.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Ensure the Gradle build script is configured with correct SDK versions and dependencies for a robust build.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Create a simple user interface with a TextView to display a count and a Button to increment it.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Set up the MainActivity to handle UI interactions and manage the counter state.

steps.title: Initialize SharedPreferences for Local Storage
steps.description: Prepare SharedPreferences to persistently store the counter value across app sessions, fulfilling the 'offline' requirement.

steps.title: Load Stored Counter Value
steps.description: On app startup, retrieve the last saved counter value from SharedPreferences and display it.

steps.title: Handle Increment Button Clicks
steps.description: Implement an OnClickListener for the button to increment the counter value.

steps.title: Save Current Counter State
steps.description: After incrementing, save the new counter value back into SharedPreferences to ensure persistence.

steps.title: Update UI Display
steps.description: Refresh the TextView to show the most current counter value after each increment or load operation.

steps.title: Declare Application in AndroidManifest
steps.description: Ensure the AndroidManifest.xml correctly declares the application, activities, and permissions.

steps.title: Building Offline App
steps.description: Compiling and packaging the 'Offline App' application.
